site.name: B2B Fee Audit
site.legal_entity: Research Triangle Park AI Transformation LLC
site.description: Deterministic B2B Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and hidden-fee auditor for Multi-State Payroll/HRIS/EOR (Gusto, Rippling, Deel, OnPay, ADP, Paychex) and Merchant Credit Card Processing (Stripe, Square, PayPal, Shopify vs. Helcim, Stax, CDG Interchange-Plus).

tools.name: calculate_payroll_hris_tco
tools.title: Payroll & Multi-State HRIS 12-Month TCO Calculator
tools.description: Calculates deterministic 12-month all-in cost across Gusto, OnPay, Rippling, Deel, ADP RUN, and Paychex Flex including base fees, W-2 PEPM, 1099 contractor fees, extra-state tax filing surcharges, year-end W-2/1099 fees, and global EOR FX spreads.

contractors_1099.description: Number of US 1099 contractors paid monthly

us_states.description: Number of US states with active W-2 tax withholding/SUI accounts

primary_state.description: Two-letter US state code for primary SUI wage-base lookup

tools.name: audit_merchant_processing_fees
tools.title: Stripe & Merchant Processing Interchange-Plus Fee Auditor
tools.description: Audits monthly credit card volume, average ticket size, card-present vs. online/invoicing mix, and international percentage to calculate true effective rate and 12-month savings switching from Stripe (2.9%+$0.30), Square, or PayPal to Helcim, Stax, or CDG Interchange-Plus.

monthly_volume_usd.description: Total monthly gross card processing volume in USD

online_cnp_pct.description: Percentage of volume processed online, keyed, or via B2B invoice

international_pct.description: Percentage of volume from non-US cards or requiring currency conversion

tools.name: compare_1099_vs_w2_employer_tax
tools.title: US 1099 Contractor vs. W-2 Employee True Employer Tax Load Comparator
tools.description: Calculates statutory employer payroll tax load (7.65% FICA + 0.6% FUTA + official 2026 .gov state SUI wage base & rate + Workers Comp + benefits load) versus 1099 independent contractor hourly/annual compensation.

state_code.description: Two-letter US state code (e.g., CA, NY, TX, FL, NC, WA)
